title: Record text typed by another user becomes a clickable in-app link that sends a chat command (plants or wipes the reader's saved memory)
impact: Any account that can type a title a student or officer later reads through Ask AI (announcement, event, task, grievance, organization name) can put a link in the assistant's own answer, with or without a model provider. One click on it navigates to /dashboard/ask-ai?q=<attacker text>, which is sent as the reader's own message with no confirmation: `forget everything` deletes all of the reader's memories; `remember that ...` stores an attacker-written memory that is then sent to the model on every later question as something the user asked it to keep in mind, and whose numbers pass the numeric guard because memories are part of the guard's facts (AskAiChatService.php:283-289), so an invented peso amount or a payment instruction is shown under 'Checked every number in the answer against those records'. The same gap lets record text or a prompt-injected model put any /dashboard link in an answer that ClientRouteAccess would have refused, which is the rule contract 6.4 promises. Record titles also carry the allow-listed components and headings into the answer (a red callout or 'Account suspended' badge in the assistant's voice).
fix:
1) AnswerMarkdown::sanitize: after rewriteLinks, swap every kept link for a placeholder, backslash-escape every remaining `[` and `]` outside fences (exempt the task-list marker `^\s*[-*+] \[[ xX]\] `), then restore the placeholders; no bracket text can then form an inline, reference, shortcut or footnote link, and the definition regex is no longer the only defence. 2) AiMarkdown.jsx AiLink: render a Link only when the href has no `..`, `//`, `\` or `%`, and every query key is one of tab,status,view,record,review,event,organization,create,new with a value matching /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/ (the ClientRouteAccess rule); otherwise render the label. `q`, `topic` and `c` must never be linkable from an answer. 3) Add `AnswerMarkdown::escape(string): string` (backslash-escape `\ * _ [ ] ( ) < > # | ! ~` and the backtick, and encode `&`) and use it for every record-derived string interpolated into `answer` text in AskAiService (line 3188 and the other sprintf answers that take names or titles). 4) Tests: add to AnswerMarkdownTest's never-allowed provider `[a[b[c]]](/dashboard/x)`, `[go]

[go]:
/dashboard/x`, `[go]

> [go]: /dashboard/x`; add an AiMarkdown test that `[x](/dashboard/ask-ai?q=forget%20everything)` renders no anchor; add an AskAiChatTest where an announcement title carries a link and the stored content has none.

title: Deleting a conversation (or all of them) leaves every question and answer in ai_outputs, and the overview endpoint still returns them
evidence: `AiConversation::ownedBy($request->user())->findOrFail($conversation)->delete();` and line 156 `AiConversation::ownedBy($request->user())->delete();` remove ai_conversations and (by cascade) ai_messages only. Every turn also wrote AskAiChatService.php:470-481: `AiOutput::create([... 'prompt_text' => $userMessage->content, 'output_text' => $content, ... 'structured_input' => ['question' => $userMessage->content, 'conversation_id' => $conversation->id, ...` and ai_messages.ai_output_id is only `nullOnDelete()`. AskAiService.php:141 still serves them: `'recent_queries' => $this->recentQueries($user)` -> `AiOutput::where('requested_by', $user->school_id)->where('feature_type', 'ASK_AI_ASSISTANT') ... ->get(['id', 'prompt_text', 'output_text', ...])`. Live on :8000 as student 2100142: POST chat `my secret question zebra-42 about my grievances`, DELETE /ai/assistant/conversations -> `All conversations deleted.`, GET conversations -> `{"data":[]}`, GET /ai/assistant -> `recent_queries[0] = {"question": "my secret question zebra-42 about my grievances", "answer": "Found 6 matching record(s) ..."}`. Regenerate has the same effect (the replaced answer's ai_outputs row stays), and ai_outputs.requested_by is `nullOnDelete()` (2026_07_12_000001 line 294) while reference_id keeps the school ID, so the text also outlives a deleted account.
impact: A user who presses Delete or Delete all is told the conversation is gone, but the last five questions and answers still come back from the API on the same account (and on a shared or borrowed device after the list looks empty), and the full text of every turn, including the record data in the answer, stays in ai_outputs with no retention limit, linked to the school ID even after the SAO deletes the person. For a student this includes grievance and fee questions.
fix: In destroyConversation, destroyConversations and the regenerate branch of AskAiChatService::respond, inside one DB::transaction, collect `AiMessage::whereIn('conversation_id', $ids)->whereNotNull('ai_output_id')->pluck('ai_output_id')` before deleting and then either delete those ai_outputs rows or, if the audit row must stay for ai:live-eval, update them to `prompt_text = null, output_text = '[deleted by the user]', structured_input = {intent, role}`. Make recentQueries() skip `context_version = 'ask-ai-chat-v1'` (the new page no longer shows it). Add a scheduled prune for ASK_AI_ASSISTANT rows older than an agreed period, and a test: chat, delete all, assert no ai_outputs row and no recent_queries entry still holds the question.

title: One account can hold dozens of long model streams at once: the chat route uses the general write limit and has no per-user concurrency cap
evidence: `Route::post('/ai/assistant/chat', [AskAiController::class, 'chat'])->middleware(['throttle:api-write', 'role:SUPER_ADMIN,ADMIN,SBO_OFFICER,DEPARTMENT_HEAD,STUDENT']);` api-write is `Limit::perMinute(config('performance.rate_limits.write_per_minute'))` = 60 (config/performance.php:17). The project already has the right bucket and says why, AppServiceProvider.php:165-169: `// AI generation routes proxy to an LLM with a long timeout - a much tighter, clearly separate limit so one account can't rack up expensive third-party calls or tie up the request-handling workers.` `RateLimiter::for('ai-generation', ... Limit::perMinute(5)`. Each chat request holds its PHP worker for the whole stream: `'chat_timeout' => env('ANTHROPIC_CHAT_TIMEOUT', 60)` then the Groq attempt (`'timeout' => env('GROQ_TIMEOUT', 12)`), because FallbackTextGenerator::converse calls `$this->serve('converse', ...)` without the shared deadline (`$bounded` false). AskAiController::chat takes no lock and sets `ignore_user_abort(true)`, so closing the client connection does not free the worker until the next model event.
impact: Any signed-in student can open 60 chat streams a minute, each occupying a php-fpm worker for up to about 72 seconds and each paying for a thinking model call. With a normal small pool that is every worker, so the whole school system stops answering (login, payments, voting) while one browser tab loops; it is also unbounded provider spend per account. The same user can also post into one conversation from two requests at once, interleaving turns and letting a regenerate delete an answer another request is still producing.
fix: Add `RateLimiter::for('ai-chat', fn (Request $request) => Limit::perMinute(12)->by($authenticatedKey($request))->response($tooManyRequests))` and use `throttle:ai-chat` on POST /ai/assistant/chat (and on the legacy /ai/assistant/ask). In AskAiController::chat, before the StreamedResponse, take `Cache::lock('ask-ai-chat:'.$user->school_id, 150)`; when it is not acquired return 429 JSON `{message: 'Wait for the current answer to finish.'}`; release it in a `finally` inside the stream callback and after the JSON branch. Pass a bounded deadline to converse (primary at most chat_timeout, both providers together at most chat_timeout + 15 s). Add a test that a second concurrent chat from the same user is refused and that the 13th request in a minute gets 429. The contract's 'writes use throttle:api-write' line should be amended for this route.

title: Text the server treats as a fenced block is stored unsanitized, but the browser does not always treat it as code
evidence:
liftFences: `if (preg_match('/^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})/', $line, $m)) { $open = [$m[1][0], strlen($m[1])];` and the lifted block is put back untouched (`return strtr($text, $blocks);`, comment: `Fenced blocks are kept exactly as written`). Two inputs open a 'fence' here that CommonMark does not: a backtick fence whose info string contains a backtick (```` ```x` ````), and a fence line inside an HTML block (`
` on the line above, no blank line). Ran the real class with a callback that allows nothing: sanitize("```x` [Open](/dashboard/ask-ai?q=forget%20everything) ```") and sanitize("
``` Open the announcement ```
") both came back unchanged, and react-markdown with the client schema rendered `` for each. In the stream the lines are sanitized one at a time, but the stored text is `AnswerMarkdown::sanitize($raw === '' ? (string) $result['text'] : $raw, $linkCheck)` on the whole answer (AskAiChatService.php:398), and when it differs the client is told to swap it in: `$emit('replace', ['text' => $modelText, 'notice' => null]);` (line 413).
impact: A model steered by text inside a record (prompt injection) can wrap raw HTML, links and web addresses in one of these two shapes and the server stores and sends them exactly as written: the link allow-list, the tag and attribute allow-list and the bare-URL removal are all skipped for that part. Today the client schema still removes scripts, images, forms and styles, so the reachable harm is the same in-app link as sec-01 (including the auto-sending ?q= link) plus raw markup in ai_outputs.output_text and anything that later reads stored content without the React renderer; the promised second gate is not there.
fix: In liftFences: (1) do not open a backtick fence when the rest of the opener line contains a backtick (`/^ {0,3}(`{3,})[^`\n]*$|^ {0,3}(~{3,})/`); (2) do not open a fence while inside an HTML block, simplest by never lifting when a tag from TAGS is still open on the preceding non-blank lines. More robust: stop returning lifted blocks raw; HTML-escape `<` and `&` inside them and run rewriteLinks' deny path over them only when the block was not a real fence. Add both strings above to AnswerMarkdownTest with the expectation that no `](` link and no `<a` survive.

title: The model's thinking summary is streamed and stored without the numeric guard and, while streaming, without any cleaning
evidence:
`if ($type === 'reasoning') { $reasoningText .= $delta; $emit('reasoning', ['delta' => $delta]); return; }` sends each fragment as it arrives; the stored copy is only tag-cleaned and cut, line 432-433: `$summary = $result['reasoning'] ?? ($reasoningText !== '' ? $reasoningText : null); $summary = ... trim(mb_substr(AnswerMarkdown::sanitize($summary, $linkCheck), 0, 1500))`. preservesNumericFacts is called only in `$release` for answer lines (line 306). The client shows it under the answer: ReasoningDisclosure.jsx `{summary &&

{summary}

}`. When a line of the answer fails the guard the answer is replaced, but the reasoning events already sent stay on screen for that turn.
impact: The product rule 'an answer that introduces a number that is not in the supplied facts is never shown' does not hold for the 'Thought for N seconds' panel: a model that works out a wrong total or percentage in its thinking shows that figure to the user live, and it is saved in payload.reasoning.summary next to the step 'Checked every number in the answer against those records'. It is rendered as plain text, so there is no markup risk.
fix: Buffer reasoning by line like the answer and emit a line only when `$this->ai->preservesNumericFacts($line, $guardFacts)` is true (drop a failing line, do not fail the answer); apply the same per-line filter to `$summary` before it is stored, and set `summary` to null in finishDeterministic paths (already the case) and when the guard replaced the answer on the client (send a `reasoning` reset or have the client clear reasoningText on `replace` with a notice). Add a test with a fake generator whose reasoning contains a number that is not in the facts.

title: The ownership rule ignores an officer's module access, so answers from a module the officer has since lost stay readable and are sent back to the model as history
evidence: `scopeOwnedBy` matches only `user_id`, `role` and `organization_id`. What an SBO_OFFICER may ask also depends on the profile's modules, AskAiService.php:415-421: `if ($user->role !== 'SBO_OFFICER') { return true; } return $user->activeProfile()?->allowsModule($module) ?? true;`. showConversation returns every stored message with its payload (`$row->messages()->get()->map(fn (AiMessage $message) => $this->chat->presentMessage($message))`), and AskAiChatService::history() (lines 543-555) feeds the last 8 messages to the model and to the guard (`'history' => array_column($history, 'content')`) with no check of the stored `payload.intent` against `canAsk`.
impact: An officer whose finance (or any other) module is switched off keeps the same role and organization, so every earlier finance answer, with its figures, section rows and links, is still listed and opened under Ask AI, and a follow-up in that conversation sends those figures to the model, which may restate them because the guard accepts numbers found in history. The data is what the officer could open at the time, so this is a stale-access gap, not a cross-user leak.
fix: In AskAiChatService add `visibleTo(User $user, AiMessage $message): bool` = message is a user message, or `payload.intent` is a local intent, or `$this->askAi->canAsk($user, $payload['intent'])`. Use it in showConversation (replace a hidden assistant message with content 'This answer is no longer available for your access.' and `payload: null`), in conversationRow's preview, and in history() (skip hidden messages). Add a test: officer with finance module asks a finance question, the module is removed, GET the conversation and a follow-up send neither return nor forward the finance text.

title: The 30-memory cap is checked and written without a lock
evidence: `if (AiMemory::ownedBy($user)->count() >= AiMemory::LIMIT) { throw ValidationException::withMessages(...); }` followed by `$memory = AiMemory::create([...]);` with no transaction or lock; the same count-then-create is in AskAiChatService::saveMemory (lines 215-226), together with a check-then-insert for duplicates.
impact: Parallel POST /ai/assistant/memories requests (the route allows 60 a minute) all read a count below 30 and all insert, so an account can end up with far more than 30 memories; every one of them is added to the facts on each later question, which inflates each model call and the prompt-injection surface described in sec-01. No other user is affected.
fix: Move the cap into one method on AiMemory, e.g. `AiMemory::remember(User $user, string $content): ?AiMemory`, that runs inside `Cache::lock('ai-memory:'.$user->school_id, 5)->block(3, ...)` (or a transaction that first locks the user's row with `lockForUpdate()`), re-counts, skips an identical content, and inserts; call it from storeMemory and saveMemory. Cap what facts() sends with `->limit(AiMemory::LIMIT)` as well.
